title: Chana Masala
description: Chickpeas in a dark onion-tomato masala finished with amchur for sourness rather than lemon. Entirely pantry-based and better on the second day.
notes: Tinned chickpeas are fine. If cooking dried, save the cooking liquid — it thickens the gravy better than water.

ingredients.name: amchur
ingredients.note: dried mango powder; or the juice of half a lemon

steps.text: Fry the onions in the neutral oil until well past golden — properly brown at the edges.
steps.tip: Most of the colour of the finished dish comes from here. Stopping at soft and translucent gives a pale, thin curry.

steps.text: Add the ginger and garlic and cook until the raw smell goes.
Add the cumin, coriander, and turmeric and stir for thirty seconds before the tomatoes go in.
Add the tomatoes and cook down until the oil separates out at the edges.
steps.tip: Oil pooling around the masala is the signal it is ready. It is not a timing question.

steps.text: Stir in the chickpeas with a splash of water and simmer so they take on the gravy.
Crush a few chickpeas against the side of the pan to thicken, then finish with garam masala, amchur, and cilantro.
